description.html: The 100 x 30 x 80 cm cabinet is a stand for an aquarium or terrarium up to 100 cm long and 30 cm deep. The flat top supports the whole base of the tank, and underneath is a two-door cupboard that holds an external filter, food, nets and other equipment - out of sight but within reach.

An 80 cm height puts the aquarium at a comfortable viewing level whether you are sitting or standing, and the clean, handle-free white design fits any room. If you need another size, colour or a metal stand, we build them to order - see custom stands and cabinets.

Place the cabinet on a level floor and check it with a spirit level before putting the tank on it. The aquarium must rest on the top with its whole base, with nothing overhanging the edge. A full aquarium is heavy - roughly a kilogram per litre of water plus glass, sand and decoration - so fill it only once it is in its final place.
Call us or message us on WhatsApp to order and for the price. Delivery throughout Serbia, free pickup in Novi Sad.
